TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Ka tou wæ'i k'anna rou ni-mou-mala ta ti Jesus ki tallagh, ni-mirong tou tamang ki vaoung.
S.TRANSL: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
當那一天，耶穌從房子裏出來，坐在海邊。

S.FORM: Ka mabatoung ta makoilalaulau ka ni-mæu-a-klakla tyni-æn, kmahynna ka ni-mou-avang mirong ta teni, ka ymmid ki makoilalaulau ta ni-itoukoa tou sait.
S.TRANSL: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
有許多人到他那裏聚集，他只得上船坐下，眾人都站在岸上。

S.FORM: Ka ni-pasousou-en tyn ta madadagh [ki mamang] ki pæmyhkaulau l'-æn; koun, K'ytt'ei ni-tpapæ-næh [mou-æuma] alei ki diri-en ta tama-diri:
S.TRANSL: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
他用比喻對他們講許多道理，說：「有一個撒種的出去撒種；

S.FORM: Ka tou dadiri-en tyn, ni-'tkoua ta rouma [ki 'æ'æp] tou vidæh ki darang: ka ni-iroua ta ajajam ka soubuh, ka ni-[rmourouk] kman ki anna.
S.TRANSL: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
撒的時候，有落在路旁的，飛鳥來吃盡了；

S.FORM: Ka ni-'t-koua ta rouma tou vahtoh-toh-an ka ma-ousing maliih, ka ni-kæuh-rblan [ta anna] tou-oul, alei ka aousi ki malæuhæu ka Næi-râ.
S.TRANSL: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
有落在土淺石頭地上的，土既不深，發苗最快，

S.FORM: Irou râ ni-mou-tiæh ta wæ'i, dou-miaka ni-pati-hou-wyl-len, ka alei ka aousi ki patar, ni-mi-laklak-da.
S.TRANSL: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
日頭出來一曬，因為沒有根，就枯乾了；

S.FORM: Ka ni-'t-koua ta rouma tou ad-addim-an: ka ni-kmaralib ta addim, ka ni-pa-yh-patei ki anna:
S.TRANSL: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
有落在荊棘裏的，荊棘長起來，把它擠住了；

S.FORM: Ka ni-'t-koua ta rouma tou næi ka mariang, ka ni-makka-voua ki voua, sat ka'ætouh-han ta sasat, ninnim kytti-æn ta pani, ka touro kytti-æn ta rouma [ki vyttourough.]
S.TRANSL: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
又有落在好土裏的，就結實，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。

S.FORM: Timamang ta akou-tangira ki 'a-illilingigh, da millingh-gâ-ato.
S.TRANSL: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」

S.FORM: Irou ka iroua tyni-æn ta Pæhtatæutæu-en [tyn] ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Ka'umang ka masousou kow neini-æn ki pæmyh-kaulaul'-an?
S.TRANSL: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
門徒進前來，問耶穌說：「對眾人講話，為甚麼用比喻呢？」

S.FORM: Teni râ ni-mattæi-vli koumma neini-æn, Alei ka ni-phæn ymoumi-æn mou-mhaa ki kalæuhæu-en ki pei-sasou-an ki tounnoun ki vullu-vullum, râ assi ni-phæn-ato ta neni k'anna.
S.TRANSL: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
耶穌回答說：「因為天國的奧祕只叫你們知道，不叫他們知道。

S.FORM: Ka timamang ta akoumea, teni-appa ta ph'eih, ka akou-me'ah ta teni ki kahouvaran: râ timamang ta aulouh, 'ææumi-'eil-appa tyni-æn ta akoumean tyn.
S.TRANSL: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
凡有的，還要加給他，叫他有餘；凡沒有的，連他所有的，也要奪去。

S.FORM: Alei ki atta pasousou-en-au neini-æn ki pæ-myh-kaulaul'-an ki sou, alei ka tou kakytt'an nein assi kmytta-ah, ka tou 'æilling-hen nein assi millingigh-ah, ka assi mou-mha-ah ta neni.
S.TRANSL: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
所以我用比喻對他們講，是因他們看也看不見，聽也聽不見，也不明白。

S.FORM: Ka pavæuttin neini-æn ta ni-pattæi-tan ti Esajas ka k'ma, Illingh-ei-moumi ki 'æilling-hen, râ assi-kamou mou-mha-ah: ka kakytta-ei-moumi ki kakytt'-an, ka assi-kamou kmytta-ah poulilyt.
S.TRANSL: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
在他們身上，正應了以賽亞的預言，說： 你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白； 看是要看見，卻不曉得；

S.FORM: Ka kæuh-kunnum-ato ta tintin ki ta-'u k'atta, ka ni-mahouhfpit millingigh ta tangira nein: ka ni-ittub ta matta nein ki assi nein kytta-eih dou roumang ki matta, ki assi nein illing-eih ki tangira, ki assi nein omheih ki tintin, ki assi nein si-lala-eih, ki paka-darikah-aumau neini-æn.
S.TRANSL: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
因為這百姓油蒙了心， 耳朵發沉， 眼睛閉着， 恐怕眼睛看見， 耳朵聽見， 心裏明白，回轉過來， 我就醫治他們。

S.FORM: Râ akou-riang ta matta-oumi, alei ka kmyttâ-ato, ki tangira-appa-moumi, alei ka millingig-atou-râ.
S.TRANSL: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
「但你們的眼睛是有福的，因為看見了；你們的耳朵也是有福的，因為聽見了。

S.FORM: Ka d'lligh koun-nau-kamou-râ, Ka mabatoung ki na Tama-mattæi-tan ki na matiktik-appa ta ni-mamoei kmytta ka kytta-'n oumi, râ assi nein ni-k'yttan: millingigh-appa ka illingig'n-oumi, râ assi nein ni-illing-hen.
S.TRANSL: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
我實在告訴你們，從前有許多先知和義人要看你們所看的，卻沒有看見，要聽你們所聽的，卻沒有聽見。」

S.FORM: Anna ta milling-ighâ ta ymoumi ki pa-myh-kaulaul-'an ki Tama-diri.
S.TRANSL: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
「所以，你們當聽這撒種的比喻。

S.FORM: Irou millingigh ta timamang ki sou ki Pei-sasou-an tou assi tyn oumha'n, dou-miaka jroua ta ti Tatapin [ka Lyttou] ka smimourang mara ki ni-diri tou tintin tyn. Teni ta ti Ano, ka ni-diri tou vidæh ki darang.
S.TRANSL: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
凡聽見天國道理不明白的，那惡者就來，把所撒在他心裏的奪了去；這就是撒在路旁的了。

S.FORM: Teni ka ni-diri tou vahtohtoh-an ka mahourat ki næi, teni ta ti anna ka millingigh ki sou, ka matta-dys matta-rei ki anna matta-ryh.
S.TRANSL: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，當下歡喜領受，

S.FORM: Râ aousi ki patar tou mamado tyni-æn, ka tnadys tna-kaha ta teni: ka rou iroua ta sam'k-an ki kou-dylloug-han lava alei ki sou, madys paka-varau-en ato.
S.TRANSL: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
只因心裏沒有根，不過是暫時的，及至為道遭了患難，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。

S.FORM: Teni-râ ka ni-diri tou adaddim-an, teni ta ti atta ka millingigh ki sou, râ pæh-kbo-en pæh-dimdim ki yddarinoug-han k'atta ki si-mham-hân-appa ki vang-ei ta kmaralib ki sou, ka makka-p'euppæh ta-anna.
S.TRANSL: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑把道擠住了，不能結實。

S.FORM: Teni ka ni-diri tou næi ka mariang, teni ta ti atta ka dou millingigh ki sou ka moumha ki atta, ka makka-voua-appa poupænæh sat ka'ætoug-han ta saäsat, ninnim kyttiæn ta pani, ka touro kytti-æn ta rouma-râ.
S.TRANSL: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
撒在好地上的，就是人聽道明白了，後來結實，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。」

S.FORM: Ni-pou-pænæh neini-æn ki pani ki pæ-myh-kaulaul-'an, koun, Pæh-myh-kaulaul-'an ta Peisasou-an ki tounnoun ki vullu-vullum, ki ta-'u ka ni-dmadiri ki 'æ'æp ka mariang tou ouma tyn.
S.TRANSL: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
耶穌又設個比喻對他們說：「天國好像人撒好種在田裏，

S.FORM: Ka tou yrp-pen ki ta-'u, ni-iroua ta væuuh tyn, ka ni-dmiri ki ouro ka assi mariang kmi-tamæugh ki sivegh, ka ni-d'marang-atou-râ.
S.TRANSL: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
及至人睡覺的時候，有仇敵來，將稗子撒在麥子裏就走了。

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-tibbig kæuhngnara, makka-voua, ni-moupænæh-appa ta ourou ka assi mariang.
S.TRANSL: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
到長苗吐穗的時候，稗子也顯出來。

S.FORM: Ka dou mou-qua ta kouncia ki Tæi-tallagh, ni-k'ma tyni-æn: Meirang, assi kaua mariang ta 'ææ̈p ka ni-diri-en-hou tou ouma-'ho? makka-kounna ka akou-ourou ka assi mariang?
S.TRANSL: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
田主的僕人來告訴他說：『主啊，你不是撒好種在田裏嗎？從哪裏來的稗子呢？』

S.FORM: Teni-râ ni-k'ma neini-æn, Ni-pâm't-en kanna ki ta-'u ka mavæuugh. Ka ni-k'ma ta kouncia tyni-æn, Kamoei-en-hou kaua ka ouqu'ei-mian malillud ki anna?
S.TRANSL: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
主人說：『這是仇敵做的。』僕人說：『你要我們去薅出來嗎？』

S.FORM: Râ ni-k'ma ta teni, Assi, alei ka rou malillud-kamou ki ouro ka assi mariang, assi-ah-kamou lava pi-apara pouh-toul ki sivægh.
S.TRANSL: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
主人說：『不必，恐怕薅稗子，連麥子也拔出來。

S.FORM: Pa-kæuh-sâl-au patoul tou kaäjam-eih, ka tou kidi ki kaäjam-en pasousou-ei-mau ki ta-'u ka majam-ah, Siourou-â illud ki ourou ka assi mariang, ka ibbun-au ta anna tou ibbun, alei ka papilæmæ-'æuh, râ ill'ddau ta sivæh tou kouvau-au.
S.TRANSL: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
容這兩樣一齊長，等着收割。當收割的時候，我要對收割的人說，先將稗子薅出來，捆成捆，留着燒；惟有麥子要收在倉裏。』」

S.FORM: Pani-appa ki pæ-myh-kaulaul'an ka ni-pou-pænæh-en tyn neini-æn, koun, Mama ki touhto ki s'hai [ka keiloä] ta Pei-sasou-an ki tounnoun ki vullu-vullum, ka ni-ara ki ta-'u, ka na dadiri tyn tou ouma tyn.
S.TRANSL: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
他又設個比喻對他們說：「天國好像一粒芥菜種，有人拿去種在田裏。

S.FORM: Ka siouro outi-kylling [ta anna] ki ymmid ki touhto: jrou-râ ni-kæuh-'mha-ato, siouro-ato irang ki ymmid ki ourouourou: ka kæuh-pærænnæh-ato, k'ma-appa-hynna ka jroua ta ajajam ka soubuh si-laualu tou pehil tyn-da.
S.TRANSL: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
這原是百種裏最小的，等到長起來，卻比各樣的菜都大，且成了樹，天上的飛鳥來宿在它的枝上。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-pasousou-en tyn ki pæmyh-kaulaul-'an ka pani, Mama ta Pei-sasou-an ki tounnoun ki vullu-vullum ki ni-pei-apyngit, ka ni-ara ki jna ka ni-hma tou toutouro ki sau-rarpung-an ki moé, tou kidi-appa k'anna ka ma-ymd-ato mapyngit.
S.TRANSL: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
他又對他們講個比喻說：「天國好像麵酵，有婦人拿來，藏在三斗麵裏，直等全團都發起來。」

S.FORM: Kamamang k'atta ni-masousou ta ti Jesus ki makoilalaulau tou pæmyh-kaulaul'an: ka assi ni-pasousou-en ki mamang tou aousi ki pæmyh kaulaul'an.
S.TRANSL: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
這都是耶穌用比喻對眾人說的話；若不用比喻，就不對他們說甚麼。

S.FORM: Alei ka pavæut-aul-ato ta na sou ki Tama-mattæ'i-tan, koun, Luhtoäf-ei-mau ta moutos au tou pæmyh-kaulaul-'an: Pou-pænæh-ei-mau ta ni-hâ na kidi ki ni-pa-itou-samding-en ta daroun ki ymmid ki Næi.
S.TRANSL: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
這是要應驗先知的話，說： 我要開口用比喻， 把創世以來所隱藏的事發明出來。

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-padarang ki makoi-lalaulau, ni-mou-tallagh ta ti Jesus. Ka ni-iroua tyni-æn ta Pæhtatæutæu-han tyn, koun, Pattæ'i-msing-i-kame ki pæmyh-kaulaul-'an ki ourourou ka assi mariang tou ouma.
S.TRANSL: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
當下，耶穌離開眾人，進了房子。他的門徒進前來，說：「請把田間稗子的比喻講給我們聽。」

S.FORM: Teni ta ni-mattæ'i-vli masousou neini-æn, Teni ka dmadiri ki 'ææ̈p ka mariang, teni ta Alak ki ka'æuloung.
S.TRANSL: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
他回答說：「那撒好種的就是人子；

S.FORM: Ka ouma ta ymmid ka Næi: æ'æ̈p ka mariang-da ta alalak ki Pei-sasou-an: râ ourou ka assi mariang ta alalak ki Tama-paka-t'e [ka Lyttou.]
S.TRANSL: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
田地就是世界；好種就是天國之子；稗子就是那惡者之子；

S.FORM: Râ væuæuh ka ni-dmiri ki anna, teni ta Lyttou: ka kaäjam-an ta kæuh-kahan kæuh-limoulimou ki yddarynnoug-an: râ ta-'u ka maäjam Tama-gnau ta neni.
S.TRANSL: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
撒稗子的仇敵就是魔鬼；收割的時候就是世界的末了；收割的人就是天使。

S.FORM: Anna ta mama ka palil'dden ta ourou ka assi mariang, ka papillalamæh-in ki apoei, kma-al-appa-hynna tou kæuh-kahan kæuhlimoulimou ki yddarynnoug-an.
S.TRANSL: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
將稗子薅出來用火焚燒，世界的末了也要如此。

S.FORM: Ka madingi-ah ta Alak ki ka-'æuloung ki Tama-gnau tyn, ka papalillud-ah tou Pei-sasou-an tyn ymmid ki paka-varau-en kmæu-eirau, ki pamut-appa ki katoukoul-an:
S.TRANSL: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
人子要差遣使者，把一切叫人跌倒的和作惡的，從他國裏挑出來，

S.FORM: Ka 'aring-an-ei nein smakiqua neini-æn tou tatoulou-an ki apoei: tou hynna-al-ato ta tangitangi-en ki patit-ing-en appa ki waligh.
S.TRANSL: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
丟在火爐裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。

S.FORM: Tou kidi k'anna matikanag-ah ta matiktik mama ki wæ'ï tou Pei-sasou-an ki Rama nein. Timaman ta akou-tangira tou illing-han, illing-hau-ra.
S.TRANSL: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
那時，義人在他們父的國裏，要發出光來，像太陽一樣。有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」

S.FORM: Mila, mama ki kavangei-an ka ni-hâ tou ouma ta Pei-sasau-an ki tounnoun ki vullu-vullum, ka rou paki-valei-en ki ta-'u, ha-in tyn ta anna, ka alei ki karaj-en ki rÿh oukoun tyn pasa-dimma ki mamang tyn, ka peila ki ouma k'anna.
S.TRANSL: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
「天國好像寶貝藏在地裏，人遇見了就把它藏起來，歡歡喜喜地去變賣一切所有的，買這塊地。

S.FORM: Mila, mama ta Pei-sasou-an ki tounnoun ki vullu-vullum ki Tama-peila, ka kmiym ki vahto ka mæænnigh ka tæ'i-qua tou koudo:
S.TRANSL: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
天國又好像買賣人尋找好珠子，

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-paki-valei tyn ta saäsat ki vahto ka mangal, oukoun tyn pa-ymmid pa-sa-dimma ki maman tyn, ka peil-'an tyn ta anna.
S.TRANSL: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
遇見一顆重價的珠子，就去變賣他一切所有的，買了這顆珠子。

S.FORM: Mil-'appa, mama ta Peisasou-an ki tounnoun ki vullu-vullum ki kakæuæur ka ni pou-vaoung-en, ka ullud ki ymmid ki nanang ki thing:
S.TRANSL: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
天國又好像網撒在海裏，聚攏各樣水族，

S.FORM: Ka rou ouh-tmoei-in ta atta, hyh-pa-pourough-in [ki Tama-oudlum] tou tæitah [ki raloum], ka rou myrroung, sakouperi-en nein ki mariang pou-qua tou sato, râ ka aryng-nein ta assi mariang.
S.TRANSL: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
網既滿了，人就拉上岸來，坐下，揀好的收在器具裏，將不好的丟棄了。

S.FORM: K'ma-al-ato-hynna tou kæuh-kahan kæuh-limou-limou ki yddarynnoug-an: sah-pænæ-'ah ta Tama-gnau, ka pa-pæ-hpiæh-ah ki assi mariang na tou tamæugh ki matiktik:
S.TRANSL: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
世界的末了也要這樣。天使要出來，從義人中把惡人分別出來，

S.FORM: Ka 'aring-ei nein smaki-qua neini-æn tou tatoulou-an ki apoei: tou hynna-al-ato ta tangi-tangi-en ki patiting-en-appa ki waligh.
S.TRANSL: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
丟在火爐裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus neini-æn, Mou-ymmid-kamou kaua mou-mha ki atta? Ni-k'ma [ta neni] tyni-æn, Hahei Meirang.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
耶穌說：「這一切的話你們都明白了嗎？」他們說：「我們明白了。」

S.FORM: Teni râ ni-k'ma neini-æn: Anna ta ymmid ki Makou-sasoulat ka ni-pæhtatæutæu-en tou Pei-sasou-an ki tounnoun ki vullu-vullum, mama ta teni ki Tæ'i-tallagh ka pou-pænæh ki vangei tyn ki vææu ki ri'é-appa.
S.TRANSL: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
他說：「凡文士受教作天國的門徒，就像一個家主從他庫裏拿出新舊的東西來。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma-hynna, rou ni-mattæ'i-kaha ta ti Jesus ki pæmyhkaulaul-'an k'anna, ka ni-d'marang hynna.
S.TRANSL: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
耶穌說完了這些比喻，就離開那裏，

S.FORM: Ka rou irou-'ato tou pourough ki Rama tyn ni-matæutæuuh neini-æn tou Pæu'i-sasâl-an nein, k'ma-hynna ka ni-mouh-kiap ta neni mattæ'i-k'ma-hynna, Makka-kounna tyni-æn ta kakousacyng-an k'atta ki kailgh-en-appa?
S.TRANSL: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
來到自己的家鄉，在會堂裏教訓人，甚至他們都希奇，說：「這人從哪裏有這等智慧和異能呢？

S.FORM: Assi kaua Alak ta ti atta ki Soihoe? assi kaua pananang-en ta ti jna tyn ti Maria? ki tæ'i-appa-râppa tyn ta ti Jakobus, ti Joses, ti Simon, ti Judas?
S.TRANSL: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
這不是木匠的兒子嗎？他母親不是叫馬利亞嗎？他弟兄們不是叫雅各、約西 、 西門、猶大嗎？

S.FORM: Ki niææ̈-appa tyn, assi kaua æia-ymmid æia-lam ymyt'æn? Makka kounna tyni-æn ta ymmid ki mamang k'atta?
S.TRANSL: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
他妹妹們不是都在我們這裏嗎？這人從哪裏有這一切的事呢？」

S.FORM: Ka ni-sai-sala-kouap tyni-æn [paka-t'e neini-æn mamado]. Râ ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus neini-æn, Aousi ki rikour-in loumoulugh ta Tama-mattæi-tan, dyk tou pourough tyn, tou tallagh-appa-tyn.
S.TRANSL: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
他們就厭棄他。耶穌對他們說：「大凡先知，除了本地本家之外，沒有不被人尊敬的。」

S.FORM: Ka assi tyn ni paftæu madagh ki maligh ka ring-ei tou hynna, alei ki kaurouan nein tnamsing.
S.TRANSL: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
耶穌因為他們不信，就在那裏不多行異能了。
